Subject: Access assurance & next steps after demo

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the time to walk through the demo this morning. Quick recap from the call and the minimal items we need to help your security team evaluate Redwood for production: 

1) Compliance posture: can you confirm BluePeak's current SOC 2 status (Type I/II, report date) and whether you require a vendor SOC 2 or are comfortable with our SOC 2 + attestations? Also flag if HIPAA Business Associate Agreement or a GDPR DPA will be required.

2) Identity & access controls: please let us know if you currently require SSO via SAML or OIDC, and whether SCIM-based provisioning is a must-have on day one. For RBAC, a short description of your admin roles and whether you use delegated admin or central IT provisioning would be helpful.

3) Technical artifacts: if you can share SSO metadata (IdP entityID, SSO URL, certificate) and a network diagram for any IP allowlist needs, that will speed the technical verification.

I’m attaching a short vendor security questionnaire we use to collect the above items and a template for SOC 2 evidence requests. If you prefer, we can run the questionnaire together in a 30-minute security intake call — propose Wed 29 Sep 2027 at 10:00 PT for that follow-up.

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf (survey), BP onboarding checklist (stub)

Next steps:
- Sarah, confirm which SSO protocol you prefer and whether SCIM is required by 1 Oct.
- BluePeak security: share SOC 2 summary or confirm requirement for vendor attestation.
- We’ll schedule the intake call and include an engineer for a deeper SSO/SCIM technical run-through.

Thanks — 
Rachel Kim
Growth Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@bluepeak.com>

Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 08:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Access assurance & next steps after demo

Hi Rachel — great demo, thank you. A few quick answers: 

• SOC 2: BluePeak completed SOC 2 Type II in June 2026. I’ve attached a one-page SOC summary (bluepeak-soc2-summary.pdf) for your intake team — we do not currently share the full report until an NDA is in place, but the summary outlines scope and control families.

• HIPAA/GDPR: We are HIPAA-regulated and require a BAA for any PHI handling. We also have EU customers; a standard DPA/GDPR addendum is required.

• SSO/SCIM: We currently support SAML 2.0 IdP integrations (Okta is our primary IdP). SCIM provisioning is on our roadmap; at the moment we have a manual provisioning flow plus a private SCIM integration for a couple of partners. If SCIM is required, we need a timeline that allows us to enable provisioning on your integration contract.

• RBAC/admins: Top-level admins are managed by central IT (2 people). Application-level admins are delegated to team leads; we can provide a short RBAC matrix.

On the session token retention question from your engineer — we retain short-lived session tokens for 24 hours and audit token issuance. If you need stricter control, tell us the required maximum TTL.

We can do the intake call on Wed 29 Sep at 10:00 PT; I’ll include our security engineer, Omar Khan, on the calendar invite. 

Best,
Sarah Liu
Head of Product Operations
BluePeak Health
[Attachment: bluepeak-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf)]
